prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon, this is the adjuster following up on the claim. This call is being recorded. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Thank you. Please walk me through what happened when the collision occurred.

A: I was driving in the right lane on a main road in Baytown and needed to move over to make my exit. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started to change lanes. The other vehicle came up in the left lane and clipped the side of my car. It scraped along the passenger side and pushed me toward the shoulder.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: Not clearly. It was in a blind spot, and I didn't notice it until the contact happened.

Q: Did you stop after the impact, and did you speak with the other driver?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder right away. The other driver stopped too and we exchanged information. He said he was looking at his phone for a second.

Q: Thank you. Now, you mentioned an injury. Can you describe it?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame. It swelled up within a few hours, and I can't bend it fully. Walking up stairs is painful, and I've had to limit my driving.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day, and I've been referred to an orthopedic doctor for imaging and physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?

A: Only that I've been careful to follow the doctor's instructions, and I want the claim handled so I can get my treatment covered.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
